title: Sequential foreground checks in one turn: the first loses credit as "another command of this session started" though it had finished
outcome: Two focused checks run one after the other in the same turn and root both earn credit when the first reached its terminal result before the second started. An own-session command counts as overlapping only when the two really ran at the same time.
acceptance: The cause of the 15:38Z refusal is identified and recorded: which command key a589f968870e was, and why the host treated it as overlapping run 1.

A deterministic regression shows two strictly sequential own-session focused checks in one turn both earning credit, including when the first command's terminal event is processed late; a genuinely concurrent own command still refuses credit.
The full gate and a clean review pair on the exact input.
